description: Ares is an autonomous security operations platform where LLM-driven red and blue team agents operate against each other on live infrastructure, enabling realistic evaluation of attack and defense.

written.description: Puts red and blue agents on the same live infrastructure at once: one side chains Active Directory attacks, the other reads the logs and writes detections back to the dashboard. A single Rust binary.
